_doc: AL-110: the sky of the 2D client (src/client2d/sky2d.cpp computes it, tools/game_2d/native/atmos2d.cpp draws it). The sim keeps only the day's mean temperature and rain (src/sim/weather.cpp); the hours are spread from them here, the same for the same tick. sun: noon hour, day length swing over the year (hours, longest at midsummer, day 135), the noon altitude at the equinox and its swing (degrees). ambient: the light colour by the sun's altitude (degrees, rgb 0..1), blended between the keys; moon: how much the moon's phase lifts the night. clouds and rain dim it. precip: hours a wet day rains (base + per mm), snow below snow_c, sleet below sleet_c (the hour's temperature: the mean +- temp_swing, coldest at 3, warmest at 15), thunder from thunder_mmh on days warmer than thunder_c. wind: the sim's day wind (DayWeather windFromDeg/windMs, content/ai/climate.json), plus m/s in rain and storms. fog: the chance of a foggy morning by season, plus after a wet day; it lies from fog_from hours before sunrise to fog_to after, and the wind blows it off (gone at wind_clear m/s). snow: cm a mm of snow lays, melt cm a day per degree over 1. lights: object types that give light - radius (m), colour, strength 0..1, flicker 0..1, when: always | hearth (meals and evening) | evening | worked (someone working at it); window and torch are the lit windows of a house someone is in, and the torch a person carries outdoors at night. shadow: heights (m) of what casts a shadow by kind.
